ActorTalk: My partner. He's usually on time, but he still hasn't shown up. My guess is that the famous club probably held him up.
Do you want me to help you look for him?
It's alright... I'm used to waiting.
My partner and I used to wait for someone else too. Someone who never showed up. Funny thing is, every disappointment made us hope even harder the next time.
I've gotten used to that feeling. In a way, I've come to enjoy the anticipation.
